title: 第二章 几为纨絝膏粱
content_zh:
李纨不知贾珩心中所想，见其自有主见，也就不再多作言语，她本就是一味守愚藏拙的性子，别人之事都是很难过问几句。
又随意寒暄了几句，正要告辞离去。
贾珩行至廊檐之下，目送李纨离去，摇了摇头，如何对待贾家这条破船，他一时间也有些举棋不定。
「唯一所虑者，若我科举入仕，或会被视为贾家之人。」
这或许就是悲哀之处，政治斗争向来残酷无比，除非他如廊上二爷贾芸一样，安心做个升斗小民，贾家倒台后，或能独善其身。
否则，一旦科举入仕，哪怕再不愿，也难免会被视为贾家的旗帜人物。
当然，历史上也不乏多线下注的例子。
「好在……还有时间慢慢布置。」
贾珩思索了下，他心中已有一些谋划。
却说李纨带着书册，出了贾珩所居宅院，登上马车，一路回到荣国府，正要往居所而去，走不大远，就见垂花门下，俏生生站着二人，不由就是顿住步子。
只见为首之人是一个着杏黄色外裳的女人，其弯弯柳叶眉下，一双丹凤眼，隐见精明丶凌厉之芒，旁边站着一个对襟水绿色袄裙的女子，弯弯秀眉之下，琼鼻檀口，肌肤白腻。
「大嫂子，这是从哪里回来的？」王熙凤开口问道，声音清脆悦耳，如碎玉清音，说话间，就将一双似笑非笑的眸子，落在李纨手中的书册之上。
嗯，她不识几个字，原也认不得什麽书。
「凤丫头，怎麽不在老太太跟前伺候着。」李纨笑着迎上前去，见王熙凤目光疑惑，解释道：「这是从前门街柳条胡同，贾四儿哪儿取来的。」
贾珩之父在族中排行老四，故有此说。
王熙凤俏丽的丹凤眼中闪过一抹思索，恍然道：「原来是他家，贾四儿去得早，留下孤儿寡母，听说董氏也是个心气儿高的，见天儿撵着她孩子读书，偏偏那贾珩是个喜舞刀弄枪的，可把他娘气的不行。」
身为荣国府的管家媳妇，代王夫人处置府中大事小情，纵然贾珩之先父，贾四儿早已出了贾府五服之亲，可对于这种族中趣事也并非全然不知。
在这个娱乐匮乏的时代，街坊四邻之中的家事八卦，原就是谈资趣事儿。
李纨顿了下，道：「哦，这倒是我不知了，从他家出来，倒是没见那董氏。」
一听王熙凤之言，李纨心头也不由生出几分感同身受来。

想来自贾珠去后，她在家拉扯着一个孩子，这情景何尝不类贾四儿？
再想到那少年不大孩子，动静举止，就已如小大人般，却是不由想起了兰儿，也不知长大后能否为她支撑起一片天地。
王熙凤道：「年前才没了老子娘，命苦的紧，她娘一心想让进学，但这贾珩最喜舞刀弄枪，现在和蓉哥儿身旁充作常随使唤，混口饭吃。」
因为，蓉大爷常和贾琏在一起厮混，又常往王熙凤屋中串儿门，王熙风对贾蓉的身边人也有几分熟悉。
李纨心头泛起一抹疑惑，不爱读书，可临得那一手好字，这就让人称奇了。
不过少妇原也不是忧切旁人，攀藤缠幔的性子，笑道：「若无他事，我就先回去了，这会子，兰儿该下学了呢。」
王熙风笑了笑，目送李纨离去。
「珩大爷在家吗？」
贾珩正要回屋，忽地听到外间一声呼唤，抬眸看去，就见来人穿着常随短打绸衫，身量不高，斜眼看人，低眉顺眼模样。
「蓉大爷听说你大好了，今日去戏园子吃酒听曲，跟前缺个人伺候着，点名让你过去呢。」那小厮开口说道。
贾珩拧了拧眉，回忆起前身和贾蓉的交集。
贾蓉年方十六，往日最喜飞鹰走狗，寻花问柳，有时与京都权贵子弟发生口角冲突，常有殴斗之事发生。
而他因少时与表兄厮混，习些拳脚功夫，在贾蓉身旁，常有照应之举。
再加上，前身自从母亲去后，家中钱粮拮据，想入宁国府谋个差事，所以才在贾蓉身前大献殷勤。
说来，前身之所以魂归幽冥，为他所夺，也是因为此情。
如果按《红楼梦》原着的历史脉络，他最后是要在贾府谋了个二等差事的，在贾蓉之妻秦氏亡故时，露过一脸的。
不过，此刻贾蓉还未娶亲，其与营膳司郎中秦业之家的婚事还未定下。
「秦可卿……漫言不孝皆荣出，造衅开端始在宁，秦可卿这等绝世尤物，一入贾府，未来贾府之败亡就进入了倒计时。」
《红楼梦》原书记载，秦可卿死时，贾蓉二十岁，而冷子兴——这位周瑞家的姑爷，在演说荣国府时，贾蓉才十六岁。
「珩大爷……」小厮见贾珩出神，就是唤道。

贾珩就有些不想去，他受伤躺在床上这十来天，贾蓉连探望都没探望，却是见他前即日大好了，在宁荣街溜达，这才想起来使唤人。
念及此处，就道：「我二日，身子还有些不大爽利，大夫说不能饮酒，等过几日再过去。」
那小厮道：「那既是这般，我就先回话了。」
贾珩点了点头，目送小厮远去。
贾蓉丶贾琏围坐在厢房一方圆形桌子前中，时已入秋，有道是一场秋雨一场寒，二人皆着了棉衫，风流倜傥，一派儒雅风流模样。
贾琏一身蓝白色绸衫，面如傅粉，浓眉之下，一双桃花眼眸自有多情流转，掌中拿了一个酒盅，抿了一口，笑道：「蓉哥儿，亲事说的如何了？」
贾蓉拿起一个果子往嘴里塞着，心不在焉道：「现在敲定了几家，还在说着呢。」
「你啊，怎麽怏怏不乐的，怎麽，怕成亲之后，被管束着，不能出来玩儿？」贾琏猜到贾蓉的心思，笑道：「你看你二叔我，成了亲又如何？还不是想去哪儿就去哪儿？」
贾蓉不好揭破贾琏的底细，憋着笑道：「二叔所言是理。」
「怎麽不信？我在家中可是说一不二。」贾琏见贾蓉表情古怪，脸色也有些挂不住，板起面孔，以长辈的口吻教训，道：「早些成亲也是好事，你也不小了，天天在都中厮混也不像样，前日怎麽回事儿，怎麽听说你族中贾老四家中的独苗儿，被人开了瓢。」
「哎，就是和礼部侍郎家的粱公子，争一个花魁，那帮狗娘肏的，从后面偷袭我，贾珩在一旁拉了下，就挨了一记。」贾蓉提及此事，仍有些愤愤不平。
「那花魁模样俊不？」贾琏似笑非笑问道，对贾蓉也好，贾珩也罢，显然并不怎麽关注。
「二叔，我哪见得着？还不是被那礼部侍郎粱元招了入幕之宾。」贾蓉脸一下子垮下来。
「得罪了礼部侍郎家的公子，珍大哥还不将你腿打断。」贾琏打趣道。
贾蓉脸顿时苦了起来。
「好了，不说这些，待珍大哥打你，你到时只管过来寻我就是。」贾琏见贾蓉这副苦涩样，心头方惬意了一些，转而又温言宽慰。
贾蓉方转忧为喜，笑道：「二叔，冯紫英约了明天一起秋猎，二叔去不去？」
贾琏摆了摆手，笑骂道：「我才不玩儿这些，我看你是存心拿二叔我取笑。」
开国勋亲一辈，四王八公，历经近百年，其后辈子弟多不称器，疏于战阵，几为纨絝膏粱。
「不过，我倒是听前个大老爷说，听说舅老爷，将要大用了呢。」贾琏笑了笑，说道。

王子腾是他妻子王熙凤的娘家，贾史王薛四家同气连枝，如舅老爷大用，他在京都之中，也能多个依仗。
此刻贾琏和凤姐成婚不久，正是如胶似漆，恩爱两不疑的蜜月之期。
叔侄两个说笑着，不多时，一个仆人抽空插话，说道：「蓉大爷，冯家大爷来了。」
「二叔，冯紫英过来了，我去迎迎。」说着，贾蓉就是起身，向着外间而去。

content_en:
Li Wan didn't know what Jia Heng was thinking, and saw that she had her own opinions, so she didn't say anything more. She had a foolish and clumsy temperament, and it was difficult for her to ask a few words about other people's affairs.
After a few more casual greetings, he was about to say goodbye and leave.
Jia Heng walked to the eaves of the corridor, watched Li Wan leave, and shook his head. He was a little undecided about how to treat the Jia family's broken ship.
"The only thing I worry about is that if I become an official in the imperial examination, I may be regarded as a member of the Jia family."
This may be the sad part. Political struggles have always been extremely cruel. Unless he is like Jia Yun, the second master on the corridor, he can settle down and be a commoner. After the Jia family falls, he may be able to survive alone.
Otherwise, once one takes the imperial examination and becomes an official, no matter how unwilling he is, he will inevitably be regarded as the flagship figure of the Jia family.
Of course, there are also examples of multi-line betting in history.
"Fortunately...there is still time to arrange things slowly."
Jia Heng thought for a moment and had some plans in mind.
But it was said that Li Wan took the book and left the house where Jia Heng lived, got on the carriage, and returned to Rongguo Mansion all the way. He was about to go to his residence. Not far away, he saw two people standing pretty under the hanging flower door, and couldn't help but stop.
I saw that the leader was a woman wearing an apricot-yellow coat. Under her curved willow-leaf eyebrows, she had a pair of red phoenix eyes, which revealed a shrewd and sharp light. Standing next to her was a woman in a double-breasted aqua coat and skirt. Under her curved eyebrows, she had a beautiful nose and mouth, and her skin was white and greasy.
"Sister-in-law, where did you come back from?" Wang Xifeng asked, her voice as clear and sweet as jade. As she spoke, her eyes that seemed to be smiling but not smiling fell on the book in Li Wan's hand.
Well, she didn't know a few words, and she couldn't read any books.
"Girl Feng, why don't you wait in front of the old lady?" Li Wan smiled and stepped forward to greet her. Seeing Wang Xifeng's confused eyes, he explained: "This is from Jia Si'er, Liutiao Alley, Qianmen Street."
Jia Heng's father was the fourth eldest in the family, so he said this.
A flash of thought flashed in Wang Xifeng's pretty red eyes, and she suddenly said: "It turns out that this is his family. Jia Si'er left early, leaving an orphan and a widowed mother. I heard that the Dong family was also a high-spirited person. Jian Tian'er pushed her child to study, but Jia Heng was a man who liked to use swords and guns, but he was very angry."
As the housekeeper's daughter-in-law of the Rongguo Mansion, she handles the affairs of the palace on behalf of the king's wife. Even though Jia Heng's late father, Jia Si'er, has long been a relative of the Jia Mansion's fifth service, they are not completely ignorant of the interesting things about this race.
In this era of lack of entertainment, household gossip among neighbors is just interesting things to talk about.
Li Wan paused and said, "Oh, I don't know about that. I didn't see Mr. Dong when I came out of his house."
Upon hearing Wang Xifeng's words, Li Wan couldn't help but feel a little empathy.
After leaving Jia Zhu, she was holding a child at home. Isn't this scene similar to Jia Si'er?
When I think about that young man who is no longer a child, he behaves like a little adult, but he can't help but think of Lan'er, and wonders if he will be able to support her when he grows up.
Wang Xifeng said: "I lost my mother just a few years ago, and my life is very tight. Her mother wanted to go to school, but Jia Heng liked to wield swords and guns the most. Now He Rong is always at his side, making a living."
Because Uncle Rong often hung out with Jia Lian, and often visited Wang Xifeng's house, Wang Xifeng was somewhat familiar with the people around Jia Rong.
A doubt arose in Li Wan's heart. He didn't like reading, but he was so good at calligraphy, which was amazing.
However, the young woman did not have the temperament to worry about others and climb around the curtains. She smiled and said, "If there is nothing else, I will go back first. It's time for Lan'er to get off school."
Wang Xifeng smiled and watched Li Wan leave.
"Is Uncle Heng at home?"
Jia Heng was about to go back to the house when he suddenly heard a call from outside. He looked up and saw that the person who came was wearing a short silk shirt. He was not tall. He looked at the person sideways and had a low eyebrow..
"Uncle Rong heard that you are well. Today I am going to the theater to have wine and listen to music. I need someone to wait on you. I have asked you to come by your name." The boy said.
Jia Heng frowned and recalled the intersection with Jia Rong in his previous life.
Jia Rong was sixteen years old. In the past, he liked flying eagles and lackeys the most, looking for flowers and willows. Sometimes he had verbal conflicts with the children of the powerful people in Kyoto, and fights often occurred.
And because he hung out with his cousin when he was young, he learned some boxing and kicking skills, so he often took care of Jia Rong.
In addition, the predecessor's family had been short of money and food since his mother passed away, and wanted to find a job in the Ningguo Mansion, so he showed great courtesy to Jia Rong.
Speaking of which, the reason why his predecessor's soul returned to the underworld and was taken away by him was also because of this feeling.
If we follow the historical context of the original work of "A Dream of Red Mansions", he eventually found a second-class job in the Jia family, and showed his face when Jia Rong's wife Qin died.
However, Jia Rong is not married yet, and her marriage to the family of Qin Ye, the chef of the Yingshan Division, has not yet been decided.
"Qin Keqing... He talks about being unfilial and unfilial. The fight started in Ning. Once a peerless beauty like Qin Keqing enters the Jia Mansion, the countdown to the future Jia Mansion's defeat will begin."
The original book of "A Dream of Red Mansions" records that Jia Rong was twenty years old when Qin Keqing died, and Jia Rong was only sixteen years old when Leng Zixing, the uncle of Zhou Rui's family, gave a speech on Rongguo Mansion.
"Uncle Heng..." the young man called out when he saw Jia Heng was lost in thought.
Jia Heng didn't want to go. He was injured and lying in bed for more than ten days. Jia Rong didn't even visit him. However, he saw that he had recovered well the day before and was walking around Ningrong Street. Then he remembered to call someone.
Thinking of this, he said: "I'm still feeling a little unwell the next day. The doctor said I can't drink alcohol. I'll wait a few days before leaving."
The boy said: "That's the case, I'll reply first."
Jia Heng nodded and watched the boy go away.
Jia Rong and Jia Lian were sitting around a round table in the side room. It was already autumn, and there was an autumn rain and a cold. They were both wearing cotton shirts, looking suave and elegant.
Jia Lian was dressed in a blue and white silk shirt, with a face as pink as powder. Under his thick eyebrows, his peach blossom eyes were full of emotion. He took a wine cup in his hand, took a sip, and said with a smile, "Brother Rong, how did the marriage go?"
Jia Rong picked up a fruit and stuffed it into her mouth, and said absently: "Now we have finalized a few, and we are still talking about them."
"Why are you unhappy? Why are you afraid that after you get married, you will be controlled and not allowed to go out to play?" Jia Lian guessed Jia Rong's thoughts and said with a smile: "Look at your second uncle and me, what if we get married? Why don't we just go wherever we want?"
Jia Rong didn't want to reveal Jia Lian's background, so she suppressed a smile and said, "What my second uncle said is true."
"Why don't you believe it? I always tell the truth at home." Jia Lian saw Jia Rong's strange expression and her face was a little uneasy. He straightened his face and lectured in the tone of an elder: "It is also a good thing to get married early. You are not young anymore, and it is not decent to hang around in the capital every day. What happened the day before yesterday? Why did I hear that the only child in the family of Jia Laosi, the fourth member of your clan, was shot."
"Hey, I was competing with Mr. Liang from the family of the Minister of Rites for an oiran. Those bitches attacked me from behind. Jia Heng pulled me aside and got a slap." Jia Rong mentioned this, still a little aggrieved.
"Isn't the oiran handsome?" Jia Lian asked with a faint smile. He obviously didn't pay much attention to either Jia Rong or Jia Heng.
"Second uncle, how can I see you? Isn't it because Liang Yuan, the minister of etiquette, invited him to join the show?" Jia Rong's face suddenly fell.
"Brother Zhen won't break your legs if you offend the son of the Minister of Rites." Jia Lian joked.
Jia Rong's face suddenly turned bitter.
"Okay, let's not talk about this. When Brother Zhen beats you, just come and look for me." Seeing Jia Rong's bitter look, Jia Lian felt a little more comfortable, and then spoke warmly to comfort him.
Jia Rongfang turns worries into joy, smiled and said: "Second uncle, Feng Ziying made an appointment to go hunting together tomorrow. Will uncle go?"
Jia Lian waved his hand and said with a smile: "I don't play with these things. I think you are deliberately making fun of me, my second uncle."
The founder of the country had a generation of relatives, four kings and eight princes. After nearly a hundred years, most of his descendants were not skilled in weapons, neglected the battle formation, and were mostly playboys.
"However, I heard from the previous elder that my uncle is going to be of great use." Jia Lian smiled and said.
Wang Ziteng is the natal family of his wife Wang Xifeng, and the four families of King Jia Shi and Xue are closely related. Like his uncle, he can rely on many people in Kyoto.
At this moment, Jia Lian and Sister Feng had not long been married, and they were in their honeymoon period when they were inseparable and in love.
The uncle and nephew were chatting and laughing. After a while, a servant took the time to interrupt and said, "Uncle Rong, the Feng family's uncle is here."
"Second uncle, Feng Ziying is here. I'll go and greet her." With that said, Jia Rong stood up and headed outside.
